```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))

axis_lab_T <- expression("Temperature, " * T * " (" * degree * C * ")")
axis_lab_O2 <- expression("Ambient oxygen, " * p[O[2]*","*env] * " (kPa)")
axis_lab_w <- expression("Body mass, " * w * " (g)")
fmt_01 <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% c(0, 1), as.character(as.integer(x)), sprintf("%.1f", x))
label_10pow <- function(x) parse(text = paste0("10^", round(log10(x))))

out_dir <- here("data_out", "OBISwoaFishBase")
obis_cell_file <- file.path(out_dir, "binOccurrencesCell__dT_0.50C__dO2_0.50kPa__T_0_30__pO2_0_30.csv")
stopifnot(file.exists(obis_cell_file))

cfg <- list(
  LOCAL_PATH = "/../environment/",
  WOA_PO2_FILE = paste0(here(), "/../environment/data_out/woa18_all_pO2_kPa_an01.csv"),
  WOA_TEMP_FILE = paste0(here(), "/../environment/data/woa18_95A4_t00an01.csv")
)

stopifnot(file.exists(cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE), file.exists(cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE))

plot_dT <- 1
plot_dO2 <- 1
T_range <- c(0, 30)
O2_range <- c(0, 30)

mass_levels_ex <- c("10^1 g", "10^5 g")
mass_labels_ex <- c("w == 10^1~g", "w == 10^5~g")

target_group <- "epipelagic"
Q_low <- 0.01
T_segments <- tibble(T_lo = c(0, 10, 20), T_hi = c(10, 20, 30))
```

```{r helpers}
scale_fill_blue_counts <- function(fill_title = "Occurrences") {
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#67A5CA", high = "#251A2D", trans = "log10", name = fill_title)
}

th <- theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)

to_bin_center <- function(x, binwidth, xrng) {
  x2 <- pmin(pmax(x, xrng[1]), xrng[2] - 1e-10)
  floor((x2 - xrng[1]) / binwidth) * binwidth + xrng[1] + binwidth / 2
}

woa_wide_to_long <- function(df, value_name) {
  depth_cols <- setdiff(names(df), c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE"))
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(depth_cols), names_to = "depth_col", values_to = value_name) %>%
    mutate(depth_m = readr::parse_number(depth_col)) %>%
    select(-depth_col)
}

parse_k_from_mass_bin <- function(lbl) {
  as.numeric(sub(".*10\\^(-?\\d+).*", "\\1", as.character(lbl)))
}

weighted_quantile <- function(x, w, probs = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  x <- x[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  o <- order(x)
  x <- x[o]; w <- w[o]
  cw <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  approx(x = cw, y = x, xout = probs, ties = "ordered")$y
}

weighted_log_quantile_po2 <- function(po2, w, q = 0.10) {
  ok <- is.finite(po2) & po2 > 0 & is.finite(w) & w > 0
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  10^(weighted_quantile(log10(po2[ok]), w[ok], probs = q))
}
```

```{r data-prep}
tO2_obis_cell <- readr::read_csv(obis_cell_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

tO2_plot <- tO2_obis_cell %>%
  mutate(
    T_bin = to_bin_center(T_bin, plot_dT, T_range),
    O2_bin = to_bin_center(O2_bin, plot_dO2, O2_range)
  ) %>%
  group_by(group, mass_bin, T_bin, O2_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

woa_temp <- readr::read_csv(cfg$WOA_TEMP_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)
woa_po2 <- readr::read_csv(cfg$WOA_PO2_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

woa_occ <- inner_join(
  woa_wide_to_long(woa_temp, "temp_C"),
  woa_wide_to_long(woa_po2, "pO2_kPa"),
  by = c("LATITUDE", "LONGITUDE", "depth_m")
) %>%
  filter(is.finite(temp_C), is.finite(pO2_kPa),
         between(temp_C, T_range[1], T_range[2]),
         between(pO2_kPa, O2_range[1], O2_range[2])) %>%
  mutate(
    T_bin = to_bin_center(temp_C, plot_dT, T_range),
    O2_bin = to_bin_center(pO2_kPa, plot_dO2, O2_range)
  ) %>%
  count(T_bin, O2_bin, name = "woa_n") %>%
  mutate(woa_frac = woa_n / sum(woa_n), rare_woa = woa_frac < 0.01)
```

```{r thresholds-by-T}
min_po2_by_seg <- tO2_obis_cell %>%
  filter(group == target_group, mass_bin %in% mass_levels_ex) %>%
  mutate(k = parse_k_from_mass_bin(mass_bin)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(T_segments) %>%
  filter(T_bin >= T_lo, T_bin < T_hi, is.finite(O2_bin), is.finite(n), n > 0) %>%
  group_by(mass_bin, T_lo, T_hi) %>%
  summarise(
    pO2_min_kPa = weighted_log_quantile_po2(O2_bin, n, q = Q_low),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

min_po2_by_seg
```

```{r epipelagic-state-space}
obis_ex <- tO2_plot %>%
  filter(group == target_group, mass_bin %in% mass_levels_ex) %>%
  mutate(mass_lab = factor(mass_bin, levels = mass_levels_ex, labels = mass_labels_ex))

grid_df <- tidyr::crossing(
  mass_lab = factor(mass_labels_ex, levels = mass_labels_ex),
  T_bin = seq(T_range[1] + plot_dT / 2, T_range[2] - plot_dT / 2, by = plot_dT),
  O2_bin = seq(O2_range[1] + plot_dO2 / 2, O2_range[2] - plot_dO2 / 2, by = plot_dO2)
) %>%
  left_join(woa_occ, by = c("T_bin", "O2_bin")) %>%
  left_join(obis_ex %>% select(mass_lab, T_bin, O2_bin, n), by = c("mass_lab", "T_bin", "O2_bin")) %>%
  mutate(rare_woa = if_else(is.na(rare_woa), TRUE, rare_woa))

seg_plot <- min_po2_by_seg %>%
  mutate(mass_lab = factor(mass_bin, levels = mass_levels_ex, labels = mass_labels_ex))

ggplot() +
  geom_tile(data = grid_df %>% filter(rare_woa), aes(T_bin, O2_bin), fill = "grey82", width = plot_dT, height = plot_dO2) +
  geom_tile(data = grid_df %>% filter(!is.na(n), n > 0), aes(T_bin, O2_bin, fill = n), width = plot_dT, height = plot_dO2) +
  geom_segment(data = seg_plot,
               aes(x = T_lo, xend = T_hi, y = pO2_min_kPa, yend = pO2_min_kPa),
               linewidth = 1.5, color = "#67A5CA") +
  facet_grid(. ~ mass_lab, labeller = label_parsed) +
  scale_fill_blue_counts("Cells") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30), limits = T_range, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30), limits = O2_range, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = axis_lab_T, y = axis_lab_O2,
       title = "Epipelagic occurrence state space with minimum oxygen thresholds") +
  th
```
